prompt: Finish manifest.sh, a strict-mode directory integrity CLI: `bash manifest.sh create ROOT MANIFEST` or `bash manifest.sh verify ROOT MANIFEST`. ROOT must be a directory. MANIFEST is outside ROOT and its parent exists. Recursively inventory regular non-symlink files; ignore all symlinks (including directory links) and directories. Names may contain spaces, glob characters, backslashes, Unicode and leading dashes but never tabs/newlines. create writes/replaces MANIFEST with records `lowercase_sha256<TAB>relative/path<LF>`, sorted by relative path in C byte order, and prints nothing. Hash raw bytes. Empty roots produce an empty manifest. verify accepts records in any order, with or without final LF; it must reject malformed hashes, missing/extra tabs, empty paths, absolute paths, empty path components, . or .. components, and duplicate paths before reporting integrity. A valid manifest matches only if the entire current inventory (names and contents) matches, so missing files, modified bytes, extra regular files and replacement by symlinks are mismatches. Success verification prints exactly `OK N` plus LF (N files), exit 0. Integrity mismatch prints exactly `MISMATCH` plus LF, exit 1. Invalid invocation, bad ROOT, missing/nonregular MANIFEST for verify or malformed manifest: exit 2, diagnostic stderr and empty stdout. Keep `set -euo pipefail`. Filesystem access succeeds for valid inputs. Do not change CLI signatures. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
